Echols Memorial Hall]] |champion= MEAC North Division and tournament champions |tourney = [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First round }} {{2020–21 MEAC men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball team''' represented [[Norfolk State University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Spartans, led by eighth-year head coach [[Robert Jones (basketball, born 1979)|Robert Jones]], played their home games at the [[Joseph G. Echols Memorial Hall]] in [[Norfolk, Virginia]] as members of the [[Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference]]. With the creation of divisions to cut down on travel due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they played in the Northern division.{{Cite news|url=https://meacsports.com/news/2020/12/14/meac-announces-revised-conference-schedules-for-mens-womens-basketball.aspx|title=MEAC Announces Revised Conference Schedules for Men's, Women's Basketball|work=Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference|date=December 14, 2020|accessdate=January 7, 2021|language=en|archive-date=January 7, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210107213410/https://meacsports.com/news/2020/12/14/meac-announces-revised-conference-schedules-for-mens-womens-basketball.aspx|url-status=live}} They finished the season 17–8, 8–4 in MEAC play to finish in tie for first place in the Northern division. They defeated [[2020–21 North Carolina Central Eagles men's basketball team|North Carolina Central]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]] and advanced to the championship when [[2020–21 North Carolina A&T Aggies men's basketball team|North Carolina A&T]] withdrew from the tournament due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19]] protocols. They defeated [[2020–21 Morgan State Bears men's basketball team|Morgan State]] to win the tournament championship. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 16 seed in the West region. They defeated [[2020–21 Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball team|Appalachian State]] in the First Four, but were eliminated by No. 1 overall seed [[2020–21 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the first round. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball team|Spartans]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 16–15, 12–4 in MEAC play to finish in a tie for second place. They were scheduled to play [[2019–20 Coppin State Eagles men's basketball team|Coppin State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]], but the remainder of the tournament was canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite
